name: experimental_all_products_and_terminal_BF16_RNE_v1
input: Four arbitrary binary32 bit patterns: even, odd, cos, sin; ready/valid transaction
operations: independent RNBF16 of all four products, then exact zero-extension to binary32
independent RNBF16 of each sum; actual 16-bit output ports
FP32_arithmetic: Pinned generated HardFloat, RNE, precision-p/unbounded-exponent tininess-after-rounding, canonical positive quiet NaN

BF16_conversion.rounding: RNE; finite overflow to signed infinity; preserve exact signed zeros and infinity
BF16_conversion.NaN: Canonical positive quiet NaN 0x7fc0; invalid exactly for signaling NaN input
BF16_conversion.flags: [invalid, divide_by_zero, overflow, underflow, inexact]; divide_by_zero is always zero
BF16_conversion.overflow: Finite input rounds to infinity: overflow and inexact
BF16_conversion.underflow: Inexact and rounded BF16 exponent field is zero; destination-encoding tininess. This is deliberately not HardFloat unbounded-exponent tininess
BF16_conversion.inexact: Finite input discards nonzero low 16 bits

aggregate_flags: OR of 4 multiply, 4 product conversion, 2 add, and 2 terminal conversion exception flags; per-node flags retained for experimental trace
protocol: Input sampled only on valid and ready; output data, trace and flags remain stable while valid and not ready; active-low asynchronous wrapper reset flushes pending inputs/outputs and clears counters. Internal HardFloat pipelines receive synchronous reset on clock edges while reset is held. Reset is held over at least two rising clocks
counters: accepted/completed transaction counters modulo 2^32; reset clears both; completed means output valid and ready
native_equivalence_scope: Conditional same-input replay of the two immutable finite BF16 historical Q/K and cos/sin corpora. No universal framework NaN, overflow, arbitrary FP32 or full-model equivalence claim
non_goals: partial RoPE layout or coefficient generation
physical_status: Not synthesized or placed; experimental trace ports add observable state; only defined simulation cycles and initiation intervals are measured
